process.source: four_side_1024.v3.config (process imported from fslw.config by the frozen V3 config module)

same_side.definition: NN/SS/EE/WW same-edge connections (the V3 U/refold core)

A_template_or_family_infeasible.meaning: no candidate from the implemented D56 families was generated at all (SPEC §8 category A/B without family-level proof of mathematical impossibility)

C_candidate_blocked_by_other_routes.meaning: candidates were generated but rejected by the strict same-plane acceptance policy (blocked by other routes and/or the geometry rules; not hidden)

honesty_interpretation.note: no mathematical impossibility is claimed; A/B/C cannot be fully separated from the saved artefacts, so the raw no_candidate_generated / no_legal_candidate split is the authoritative taxonomy

detour_definition: SPEC §6 defines the unnecessary detour against the same-endpoint Manhattan lower bound.  A 90-degree arc can be shorter than the L1 bound (arc length R*pi/2 < 2R for the same displacement), so this quantity may be slightly negative for arc-routed connections; it is reported as defined and NOT treated as an error.  The additional unnecessary_detour_vs_euclidean_mm is always >= 0 and is the true geometric detour length.
crossing_points_note: full crossing list is not embedded (size); recompute with four_side_1024.v3.metrics for figures

route_length_density.definition: sampled centreline length per 5 x 5 mm cell (mm per cell)

port_region.definition: ports_total = 4 sides x 16 connectors x 16 columns = 256 per side; routed_endpoints counts routed route endpoints per side; port_band_length_mm is the centreline length inside the 5 mm band along each edge

ports_total = 4 sides x 16 connectors x 16 columns = 256 per side; routed_endpoints counts routed route endpoints per side; port_band_length_mm is the centreline length inside the 5 mm band along each edge

path_shapes.classified_from: saved world-mm primitives (relation/pair labels are not used for the shape; router_family is recorded for provenance only and is not the classifier)

definitions.straight: no arcs; all straight primitives collinear (single straight run)
definitions.short_S: exactly one historical short-S pair (two reverse theta arcs, theta=acos(1-d/(2R))) and no quarter arcs
definitions.L: exactly one quarter arc (90 deg) plus straight primitives
definitions.U: one net 180-degree turn inside the board: 'wide_U' (two quarter arcs with straight primitives between), 'hairpin' (two consecutive quarter arcs, no straight between), or 'hairpin_short_S' (SAME_HAIRPIN_A/B: one hairpin plus one historical short-S lateral shift, still a single 180-degree same-side U path)
definitions.multi_bend_refold: more than two effective bends: three or more quarter arcs, two or more hairpins, or a short-S combined with additional quarter arcs (folded/refold path)
definitions.other: anything that does not match the families above; in V3 this is the two-quarter step transfer (two quarter arcs with opposite sweeps, net turn 0 deg, the FSLW opposite-side 'U' transfer family), kept as 'other' because the required taxonomy has no step class and 'U' is reserved for net-180-degree U/hairpin paths

u_statistics.definition: same-side 180-degree U/hairpin routes only (relation=='same' AND shape=='U' from saved primitives: wide_U, hairpin, and hairpin_short_S families); depth = inward distance from the shared board edge to the deepest point/track; track_count = number of straight segments parallel to the shared edge with length >= 0.5 mm (0 for pure hairpin-family paths that contain no straight track)

nesting.definition: an inner U nests in an outer U when its along-edge interval is contained in the outer interval and its track is deeper (larger depth from the shared edge)

adjacent_spacing.definition: consecutive U tracks per side with overlapping along-edge intervals; gap = exact minimum centreline distance between the two routes

bundles.definition: overlapping U intervals within one depth tolerance band (2 x clearance) form one bundle/arch track group

refold_statistics.definition: refold = path shapes classified multi_bend_refold from primitives; congestion = refold-only centreline length per 5 x 5 mm cell (mm per cell)

propagation_loss.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

bend_loss.note: no femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function is known; R=40 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing count is a geometric metric only

total_optical_loss.note: total optical loss cannot be reported until glass bend loss and crossing loss are calibrated; propagation loss alone is reported explicitly

legacy_polymer_estimate.note: the previous polymer bend-loss model may be quoted for comparison only, never as glass truth

legacy_arm.note: the legacy polymer bend-loss model is NOT presented as glass truth and no legacy numbers are embedded here

optical_loss_breakdown.other_losses_note: no other loss terms are modelled

strategy.name: C_round_robin
strategy.description: four-side round robin, every side mixes all three classes

A 90-degree arc can be shorter than the L1 bound (arc length R*pi/2 < 2R for the same displacement), so this quantity may be slightly negative for arc-routed connections; it is reported as defined and NOT treated as an error.  The additional unnecessary_detour_vs_euclidean_mm is always >= 0 and is the true geometric detour length.

metric_sources.class/pair counts: recomputed from routes.json and cross-checked against v3/ports.py frozen identity metadata
metric_sources.path shapes: SAVED PRIMITIVES ONLY (relation/pair label is not used)
metric_sources.crossings/violations: authoritative audit_strict.json merged when fresh (stale mtime ignored), otherwise recomputed with the independent geometry kernel

notes: shape classes are derived from saved primitives, never from the CSV relation label
bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated; only propagation loss is a physical loss number
plane is metadata only: every primitive is layer=0 2D; z is 0.0 for z1 and 0.5 for z2 and is never used inside a plane
same-side routed count is reported separately for NN/SS/EE/WW; failure reasons are reported as-is with the SPEC §8 (A)/(B)/(C) interpretation
